section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a cross-cultural study examining body image in two samples: 140 women in Harare, Zimbabwe (Study 1) and 138 age-matched Zimbabwean migrants in Britain (Study 2). The study measured actual-ideal weight discrepancy, body appreciation, and media exposure, finding that Zimbabwean women in Britain reported greater weight discrepancy and lower body appreciation than their counterparts in Zimbabwe, with both groups' body image measures associated with Western media exposure.
